item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI’s updated Model Spec gives more attention to the side effects of AI systems’ work. It asks models to consider foreseeable consequences, including effects on people other than the user, and expands guidance on controlling and communicating those effects.

The change sits alongside a new default on human agency: models should help people understand their options and act on their own goals. In practice, that means judgment about an action may involve both the user’s instructions and the consequences for others.

OpenAI says it is also exploring training methods intended to help models apply the Spec’s principles in unfamiliar situations. Results from that work have yet to be shared, and the company says its models do not yet fully reflect the behavior described in the Spec.</linkedin_post>
